text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since Neo Universe isn't feeling well,
we came to a shrine for a change of pace."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: You seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"This place is... the 'Vortex.'
One of the 'force fields' where 'wave energy' converges..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what "Astral" is. 
However, I remembered that this shrine was famous as a power spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe begins to make "contact."
Drawn by her actions, I looked up at the sky too. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making a strange sound, the black shadow zigzagged
through the air and vanished like smoke... or so it seemed.
It didn't look like the movement of a bird or an aircraft, though...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: What in the world was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Visitors" are arbitrary...
It is 『fortunate』 that we were able to "encounter" them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our outing ended with the mystery still unsolved.
Perhaps thanks to our "communion," Neo Universe
seemed to get her groove back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dark clouds suddenly gathered, and rain began to pour.
I decided to hurry back to the academy with Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ......Neo Universe was so close to "encountering" a "visitor"......

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Raindrops attenuate the "signals"...
If only there were no "barriers"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because the "contact" ended in failure,
Neo Universe was unable to regain
her form.
